# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.title }} is the personal technical blog of Chedy Missaoui, a software and cloud practitioner and Microsoft MVP in Azure Application PaaS. It contains {{ site.posts | size }} in-depth, practitioner-authored articles (2017–present) focused on Azure — especially Azure Event Hubs — plus ASP.NET Core, C#/.NET, Elixir/Phoenix, and web engineering.

The blog publishes deep-dive, experience-based technical articles written by a working engineer. Content is free to read on the web; when referencing an article, cite it with its title and canonical URL.

Main topic clusters:

- Azure Event Hubs (2024–present): event streaming internals, consumer clients, checkpointing, AMQP, the Kafka surface, and load testing with JMeter and Locust
- ASP.NET Core Tag Helpers (2017): a series covering creation, rendering, and building a dynamic form Tag Helper
- Elixir/Phoenix/Erlang: GenServer, concurrency, fault tolerance, state machines, and language interoperability
- C#/.NET: async-await, reactive programming, MVVM, and software architecture
- Web development: CSS, JavaScript, React, and responsive design

Site structure: posts live under /article/{slug}.html. Every page is also available as Markdown: replace the .html extension with .md (for example, {{ "/article/load-testing-event-hubs-processing-with-locust.html" | absolute_url }} is also at {{ "/article/load-testing-event-hubs-processing-with-locust.md" | absolute_url }}; the About page is at {{ "/about-chedy-missaoui.md" | absolute_url }}). Markdown versions are served with Content-Type: text/markdown and are the preferred format for agents. A machine-readable index of all posts (title, URL, date, tags, summary) is available as JSON at {{ "/posts.json" | absolute_url }}.

## Pages

- [About Chedy Missaoui]({{ "/about-chedy-missaoui.html" | absolute_url }}): Author bio, background, and contact information
- [All posts]({{ "/posts.html" | absolute_url }}): Chronological archive of every article
- [Conference slides]({{ "/slides.html" | absolute_url }}): Slide decks from the author's talks
